differences: The paper says six volunteers took part in control experiment 2; the deposit has eight participant numbers in that experiment (each with 360 trials per contrast, as the paper's trial count implies), so all are rows.
2 planned trials have no gaze file in the deposit (Low Contrast step-ramp, one participant, block 3), so they are not rows.

The paper excluded trials during analysis (for example with blinks or anticipatory pursuit); the deposit has no exclusion flags, so excluded_by_authors is False throughout. The EyeLink flags mark blinks and saccades.

The paper's saccade latencies, landing errors and pursuit values are not in the deposit as numbers (it holds raw gaze only), so none of them was reproduced; the published checks are counts of participants, trials and the sampling rate.
